purpose: Migrate browser evidence to canonical products after deleting the standalone renderer. This is a change ledger, not a blanket qualification claim.

fixture.setup: node tests/fixtures/build-inspection.ts (DESERT_INSPECTION_BUILD selects an explicit output for frozen-source test windows)
fixture.contract: A test-only composeProduct mounts the real Notebook Notes module and an explicitly authored Visual catalog destination. Both use the same shared renderer and visual bank.

changes.before: Older probes expected a Learn More hero action, a private detail-image wrapper, vertically centered multi-line toolbar blocks and glass on the inner listbox. Some began resize or paint comparisons while the initial responsive hero image was still decoding.
changes.after: Card navigation opens the real detail, while the shared photo hero opens its viewer. Probes use the heading and PhotoCollection owners. Tall identity text starts beside the leading control; shorter blocks remain centered. Floating glass is measured on the Popover pane containing the listbox. Image readiness is awaited before resize or paint isolation, not ignored in diagnostics.
retained: real Back navigation and direct drag
exact zero changed pixels outside the sidebar pane

changes.before: Bits forceMount retained data-starting-style on a directly revealed overlay. The shared entrance endpoint added -64px translation and opacity0 to the finger-driven transform; a committed open drawer remained invisible at x=-52 instead of x12. The old catalog animation:none rule did not address CSS transitions.
changes.after: The shared surface motion owner suppresses entrance endpoints while the pointer supplies position and on a gesture-committed open state. Normal button entry and later closure keep their existing motion. The obsolete catalog-specific animation suppression was removed.
retained: no gesture state leaking to subsequent button entry

changes.before: The isolated Svelte helper mounted components before injecting the global theme. Moving an owner rule into a component could therefore establish components before base in CSS layer order, unlike the generated application bootstrap. The difference was observed in computed border styles and exact toolbar pixels.
changes.after: An optional initialCss fixture port loads the real compiled theme before component mounting. Both baseline and candidate use that order and assert its presence during initialization. The generated layout imports theme.css; Inspection K prerendered HTML loads its stylesheets before the bootstrap script. Earlier source snapshots remain unchanged.
retained: geometry/typography relocation exact pixels with no tolerance
Button exact script/markup, eight relocated declarations and cascade layers
search closed, writing and cleared states
changes.rasterQualification: Button raster parity is NOT certified. An identical-source, identical-DOM, same-page control also produced sparse 1–2 RGB differences after two individually stable frames. The exact-pixel probe and control remain diagnostic under .local/button-exact-dom.test.ts and .local/button-identical-dom.test.ts, with PNG evidence under .local/button-writer-parity. No tolerance, ignored region or baseline reset was introduced. The regular gate asserts byte-identical markup/script, literal rule relocation and exact computed styles/bounds; it does not claim screenshot equality.

changes.before: Navigation probes treated every button in the old inner nav as a destination and inspected text before the shared Button content wrapper existed.
changes.after: The complete navigation Place remains the landmark. Destination assertions select actual sidebar-menu-button owners and their text children, excluding header/footer actions. Focus containment uses the navigation role rather than a specific HTML tag.

changes.before: Press fixtures depended on the retired standalone renderer, fabricated review/Confirm actions and older geometry selectors.
changes.after: Real Notebook typed contexts and shared catalog controls exercise the canonical 0.96 press-content scale and box-shadow feedback. Date selection commits on keyboard activation and closes its picker. Wide controls retain 13px text while prose is 16px; compact icon fallback follows measured overflow at enlarged text, not a viewport label. Grouped rows use their actual GroupedPanel owner.
retained: no fabricated review or confirmation authority

changes.before: The deleted standalone renderer supplied implicit catalog navigation, synthetic execution contexts and fake form/review actions.
changes.after: Catalog navigation is an authored destination. Diagnostic specimens do not execute product operations. Form, review, read, row and toolbar assertions use real published Notebook journeys with canonical prepare/accept receipts.
retained: no mutation when only inspecting or closing

changes.before: Single selection was asserted as a modal confirmation flow with nested field groups.
changes.after: The shared selection control is an anchored non-modal listbox. Keyboard navigation does not commit; explicit Enter/click commits. Escape restores the trigger; Tab can leave the popover.

changes.before: Money assertions ignored declared locale and required compound wells to remain the same total height at every width.
changes.after: Money uses its declared decimal separator and exact decimal text. Shared row padding, line height and minimum height stay identical; compound rows may wrap at compact widths rather than overlap controls.
retained: draft retained on invalid currency switch

changes.before: Crossing the drag threshold while the pointer remained down was expected to dismiss immediately; grip focus was asserted on a span selected before the shared button content wrapper existed.
changes.after: The current drawer contract holds the gesture until release and permits reversing to cancel. Keyboard focus uses the shared Button boundary; the visual grip mark stays smaller than its at-least-44px hit target.

changes.before: Unknown availability was expected to use the primary-action color.
changes.after: Unknown inherits neutral status text. Ready remains positive; unavailable remains warning. Pending action icons inherit the button foreground.
retained: semantic color in light and dark
stable pressed rows and corner ownership

changes.before: Axe found internal toolbar/content headers announced as page banners, repeated unavailable landmarks, and an embedded media rail skipping a heading level.
changes.after: Shared owners use generic containers for pane chrome, note semantics for unavailability, and a continuous embedded heading outline. The navigation Place is one landmark containing its top toolbar, content and bottom dock. No CSS, material, spacing or motion changes were made for these fixes.
